claim_text: The CHU de Bordeaux says its investigations confirmed a compromise of its information system
summary: On Nov 24 the hospital said its investigations "confirmed a compromise of the CHU's information system" and called those responsible "the authors of this attack".
detail: The hospital's update of Nov 24, 9:30. The Record and Egora report the same confirmation.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The hospital's own Nov 24 update says so ("ont confirmé une compromission du système d'information du CHU"); The Record and Egora report it.

claim_text: Two of the hospital's email addresses were used fraudulently to send mass emails to its staff
summary: The hospital says two of its email addresses were used fraudulently to send emails in bulk to professionals working there, and that this is how it detected the incident.
detail: The hospital has not said what the emails contained.
label: Confirmed

claim_text: On Nov 23 the hospital said it had found no sign of a compromise at that stage
summary: In its first update, on Nov 23 at 11:00, the hospital said that "at this stage, no sign of compromise of the information system has been detected". It said the opposite the next morning.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 23 update says so in these words.

claim_text: An extortion group called Scarlettgroup claims it carried out the attack and threatens to publish stolen data
summary: Scarlettgroup claims responsibility and says it holds medical records, prescriptions, lab results, imaging, financial and staff documents and access details. It threatens to publish them; its claim page shows a negotiation deadline.
detail: This is the group's claim, reported by The Record and by Egora (citing Sud Ouest and the French Breaches platform). The group's own page is not linked or cited here. Egora reports that nothing shows a ransom was actually demanded or that talks are under way.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Both outlets report the group's claim and what it says it holds.

claim_text: The hospital has not confirmed the group's claims or linked the incident to it
summary: The hospital's updates do not mention Scarlettgroup, and it has not confirmed what the group says it took.
detail: The Record says the hospital has not confirmed the hackers' claims and is investigating whether any information was stolen; Egora says it has not made a direct link to the group.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 24 update names no group; The Record and Egora say the hospital has not confirmed the claims or linked them.

claim_text: The hospital is still working out which data the attackers reached and whether any was taken
summary: The hospital says technical analysis continues to establish exactly which systems and data the attackers could reach, how far the incident goes, and whether data was taken out.
label: Confirmed

claim_text: The hospital says patient care is not affected; it cut outside access to one server as a precaution
summary: The hospital says no impact on its operation has been seen: hospital activity continues normally and patients are being cared for. As a precaution it temporarily suspended access to one of its servers from outside the hospital.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Nov 24 update says so; The Record reports it.

claim_text: The hospital informed the authorities, including the national cyber agency ANSSI, notified the data protection authority and will file a complaint
summary: The hospital says the authorities, including ANSSI (France's national cybersecurity agency), were informed, a crisis unit was set up, a declaration was made to the CNIL (the data protection authority) and a criminal complaint will be filed.
label: Confirmed

claim_text: People who may be affected will be contacted individually
summary: The hospital says anyone possibly affected will be contacted individually and told which data is involved and what to watch out for.
detail: It has not said how many people that may be.
label: Confirmed

claim_text: Documents the group posted, as reviewed by a breach-tracking platform, include old letters and medical files; how many records it holds is unknown
summary: Per Egora, the French Breaches platform reviewed files the group posted: a 2014 letter, eye-care files from 2016 and 2019 and a 2023 claim form, some with health data on identifiable people; it cannot tell how many records the group has.
detail: The documents have not been checked by the hospital or by any official body. The desk has not seen them and never opens a group's leak page.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Egora reports what French Breaches found and quotes it.

claim_text: Hospitals in Gironde asked their staff to be vigilant
summary: Egora, citing Sud Ouest, reports that hospitals in the Gironde department asked their staff to be vigilant after the group's claim.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Egora reports it from Sud Ouest.

claim_text: Two other French health bodies disclosed cyberattacks the same week; whether they are linked is not known
summary: The Record reports that the University Hospital of Guadeloupe and France's National Cancer Institute disclosed cyberattacks the same week, and that it is unclear whether the incidents are linked.
detail: The Guadeloupe hospital attack has its own page on this site.
label: Reported
